text: 记者从术理创新（上海）智能科技股份有限公司（以下简称“术理创新”)获悉，9月4日，术理创新正式启动科创板上市辅导。证监会官网IPO辅导公示系统显示，术理创新于2026年9月4日在上海证监局办理辅导备案登记，正式启动科创板IPO进程，华泰联合证券担任术理创新本次上市的辅导机构。资料显示，术理创新2015年成立，注册地为上海奉贤。公司以非侵入式路线为主，核心产品聚焦中枢神经损伤导致肢体运动障碍，意识与认知障碍，和神经发育障碍等市场痛点。在2026世界人工智能大会期间，术理创新展出的核心产品包括脑机接口运动神经功能重塑产品套装、脑机接口电刺激治疗仪、脑机接口数
text_en: According to information from Shuli Innovation (Shanghai) Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. (hereinafter 'Shuli Innovation'), the company officially initiated its STAR Market listing guidance on September 4. The CSRC IPO guidance disclosure system shows that Shuli Innovation filed guidance registration with the Shanghai Securities Regulatory Bureau on September 4, 2026, formally commencing its STAR Market IPO process, with Huatai United Securities serving as the guidance institution. Company data shows Shuli Innovation was established in 2015 and registered in Fengxian, Shanghai. The company focuses on non-invasive approaches, with core products targeting market pain points including limb motor dysfunction caused by central nervous system injury, disorders of consciousness and cognition, and neurodevelopmental disorders. At the 2026 World Artificial Intelligence Conference, Shuli Innovation's featured products included brain-computer interface motor function reconstruction product suites, brain-computer interface electrical stimulation therapy devices, and brain-computer interface data-related products.
